summary: Tested MamanDouce UX/UI improvements for maternity mobile app. All 6 requested features verified: (1) Yellow gradient cloud tutorial popup appears on first load, (2) Info button (ⓘ) appears in bottom left after closing tutorial, (3) Clicking info button reopens tutorial, (4) Page creation with optional name - name not displayed if empty, (5) Pagination dots with random pastel colors, (6) Duplication popup on JourneyStepsPage with colored bubbles and first page as default.
seed_data_creation: Created test page without name to verify optional name feature
context_for_next_testing_agent: UX/UI improvements fully tested: (1) TutorialPopup.jsx - Yellow gradient cloud popup with 4 tips (Appui long, Créer un groupe, Dupliquer, Supprimer), uses localStorage key 'mamandouce_tutorial_dismissed'. (2) InfoButton component with data-testid='tutorial-info-button' appears in bottom left after tutorial close. (3) HomePage.js integrates TutorialPopup and InfoButton via useTutorial hook. (4) CustomizableHome.jsx - Page creation popup with optional name input, PageDots component shows pastel colored dots. (5) HomeLayoutContext.js - addPage() assigns random pastel color from PASTEL_COLORS array. (6) JourneyStepsPage.js - DuplicatePopup shows colored bubbles for each user page with 'défaut' badge on first page.
